deployment.api: https://procurax-mod8.onrender.com (Render Free web service, Docker, region Oregon)

client: Developer workstation over the public internet; scripts/load_test.py opens a new HTTPS connection per request
plan: scripts/load_plan_public.json: GET /ready (runs SELECT 1 on Neon) and GET /api/v1/meta

cold_start.note: API had been idle; includes Render waking the instance

network_baseline.note: Most per-request latency is the client-to-Oregon round trip plus a fresh TLS handshake, not server work

limitations: Public, unauthenticated endpoints only; business endpoints were not loaded because the database was not migrated at the time.
Two 30-second runs at concurrency 1 and 5 against a free 512 MB instance; not a capacity estimate.
Latency is measured from one client location and includes TLS setup on every request.
